maria_cs_ops: Heads up — want to kick off a small pilot to capture micro-feedback during onboarding and wire it into the healthscorer. Idea: 1) one-question micro-survey after first 3 product actions, 2) map responses to a short-term 'engagement' signal, 3) trigger playbook nudges for low responses. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

raj_product: Nice. What's the ask from Product vs CS Ops vs Data?

maria_cs_ops: Product: add the tiny survey hook and event. Data: help map responses to a new 'micro_feedback' metric and advise thresholds. CS Ops / Enablement: own the playbook content and SLA for reachouts.

ellie_enablement: I can draft the nudge templates (email + in-app). keep them short. also want an opt-out check.

dave_data: Can do the mapping. quick Q: do we want to weight this equally with existing behavior signals or as a fast-decay booster?

maria_cs_ops: Prefer fast-decay booster — high signal early, decays after 30 days unless renewed.

raj_product: Implementation details: event name `onboard.micro_feedback` with `response` enum (positive/neutral/negative) + `context_action_count`. small payload.

dave_data: sample SQL to start the scorer join: ```sql
-- micro feedback join
SELECT a.account_id, e.response, e.ts,
  CASE WHEN e.response = 'positive' THEN 1
       WHEN e.response = 'neutral' THEN 0
       ELSE -1 END as micro_score
FROM events.onboard_micro_feedback e
JOIN accounts a ON a.user_id = e.user_id
WHERE e.ts > now() - interval '60 days';
```

maria_cs_ops: perfect. For playbook triggers: micro_score <= -1 OR (micro_score = 0 AND product_action_count < 3) -> create task and send 48h follow-up.

ellie_enablement: I'll draft 3 templates: 1) quick check-in (48h), 2) offer help with first use case (5 days), 3) scheduled enablement invite (14 days).

raj_product: What metrics do we want to track in the pilot? Suggest: survey completion rate, micro_feedback distribution, conversion to active in 14 days, and playbook task resolution time.

dave_data: I'll add a dashboard tile and an alert if survey completion < 15% or playbook backlog > 200 tasks.

maria_cs_ops: Timeline proposal: 1 week to wire event + sample data, 1 week for data mapping & dashboard, 1 week for content + dry run, then 2-week pilot. Total ~5 weeks.

raj_product: Sounds reasonable. Blockers? infra? privacy?

maria_cs_ops: Privacy: event payloads must not include free text. Keep enums only. Add consent flag from signup if present.

ops_bot: deploybot: scheduled a staging deploy job for `feature/onboard-micro-feedback` at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Status: queued. :gear:

ellie_enablement: I'll start the templates today and share copies in the doc.

dave_data: I'll seed the sample dashboard and post a link once ready.

raj_product: I'll scope the event and PR. tagging @engineering once we have final event schema. :+1:

maria_cs_ops: Great — thanks team. I'll create the playbook prototype in CS Ops and follow up with a 1-pager. tagging the thread for visibility. :white_check_mark:
